events.label: U.S. personal consumption expenditures inflation August 2026

slots.name: PCE inflation
slots.sentence: Persistent inflation, which was 3.4 percent in August, as measured by the personal consumption expenditures price index, has handed Trump and the GOP a tough set of conditions heading into the midterms.

slots.name: core inflation
slots.sentence: Core prices, which outstrip more volatile food and energy costs, were up 3 percent year-over-year.

slots.name: inflation target
slots.sentence: the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) released data showing that annual inflation remained above the central bank’s 2 percent target in August.
